documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot
Demat Report For The Month Ended October, 2026.

analysis.summary: Vardhman Special Steels Limited reported record sales and a 39% increase in revenue from operations for Q2 FY27, driven by strong demand across automotive and non-automotive segments, price increases, and operational efficiencies. The foundation stone for a new forging plant was laid in July 2026, with commercial operations expected by March 2028. Management indicated that project costs for the new steel plant will be higher than the initially envisaged INR2,000 crores due to expensive land, equipment costs, and currency depreciation, while also considering a higher debt-equity ratio of 1:1 and potential suspension of dividends for 3-4 years. Vardhman Special Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, highlighting strong growth in sales volumes, revenue, and profitability. Management attributed the performance to robust customer demand, improved realizations, lower raw material inventory costs, and benefits from past capital expenditure.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the EBITDA range will remain between INR9,000 to INR12,000 EBITDA per ton.
guidance.quote: We still believe the EBITDA range will be between INR9,000 to INR12,000 EBITDA per ton.

guidance.claim: The company expects to target about 255,000 tons of volume for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: This year we are targeting about 255,000 tons for this year.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume to cross 270,000 tons next year.
guidance.quote: Next year we expect to cross 270,000.

guidance.claim: The company expects to increase its EBITDA range from 8,000-11,000 to 8,000-12,000 next year.
guidance.quote: Today, our range is 8,000 to 11,000. But next year, we should be able to increase the range from 8,000 to 12,000.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that demand was strong, partly due to GST cuts on 2-wheelers, smaller vehicles, and good SUV sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand was strong. And partly demand has been strong because of the GST cuts, which happened last year on 2-wheelers as well as the smaller vehicles as well as SUV sales have been good and the other sales also have been good.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from the non-automotive space has increased, affecting various competitors.
demand_outlook.quote: I also we are getting the feeling that from the non-automotive space also demand has increased, which has started affecting various other of our competitors.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractors are reported to be slowing down a bit based on customer feedback.
demand_outlook.quote: And tractors, what I'm hearing from some of the customers seems to be slowing down a bit.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand scenario is good and they are finding it difficult to meet customer requirements.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand scenario is good. We are, in fact, finding it difficult to meet the requirements of the customers.

demand_outlook.claim: Direct exports account for about 6% to 7% of sales.
demand_outlook.quote: So, the total exports is still accounting for about 6% to 7% direct export and another 5% is going as indirect exports through -- which is going to Aichi through the trading arm in India.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer concentration is low with Maruti representing about a 10% share.
demand_outlook.quote: As of now, it's a small percentage. That's about 10%. So, we don't have any concentration risk.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding the solar plant by another 22.5 megawatts.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are now expanding the solar plant by another 22.5 megawatts.

capex_expansion.claim: The forging plant is expected to come up by March of 2028.
capex_expansion.quote: The forging plant is expected to come up by March of '28.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is on track to complete the new steel plant project by September 2029 and stabilization by March 2030.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are on track as of now to complete the project by September of '29 and stabilization by March of '30.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans a 500,000 to 600,000 tonnes per annum greenfield plant with commissioning targeted for FY30.
The forging project cost is anticipated to be lower than the initial estimate.
capex_expansion.quote: And it looks like this project cost is going to be a bit lower than what we had estimated.

capex_expansion.claim: The new NDT and peeling lines are scheduled for commissioning by September-October of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: New NDT line will be commissioned by September, October of this year. And new peeling line will be commissioned by September, October of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to increase solar plant capacity by almost 50% in about a year to 1.5 years.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect in about a year or 1.5 years' time, we'll be going ahead and we'll be increasing the capacity by almost 50% of our solar plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The forging project is expected to be commissioned by the last quarter of FY28-29.
capex_expansion.quote: Forging project is likely to get commissioned by last quarter of '27-‘28.

capex_expansion.claim: The new steel plant is on track to be commissioned in financial year 2029-2030.
capex_expansion.quote: As of now, we are still on track to commission the project in the financial year '29-'30.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA, PAT, and revenue from operations increased significantly year-on-year for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: And revenue from operations is up by 39%, and consequently, EBITDA, PAT, they are up by about 50% for the quarter over the corresponding quarter of the last year.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improved due to robust demand and operational efficiencies from capex undertaken last year such as the Kocks Block and reheating furnace.
margins_costs.quote: The main reason for the increase in profitability, apart from the robust demand, which Sachit has already explained, is also coupled with the operational efficiencies which we have started deriving on the capex, which we have undertaken last year in the form of this putting up Kocks Block and the reheating furnace.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the benefit of lower-cost raw material inventory carried forward from the previous quarter contributed to performance.
margins_costs.quote: Our continued focus on cost optimization and operational efficiencies, the benefit of lower-cost raw material inventory carried forward from the previous quarter, and the progressive realization of benefits from last year’s capex on the Kocks Block and reheating furnace contributed to our performance.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton for the quarter stood at INR10,760.
margins_costs.quote: Overall EBITDA per ton as Sachit has already explained, it's INR10,760 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton excluding surplus fund earnings comes to INR10,700 for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: And if we remove that, our EBITDA per ton for this quarter comes to INR10,700.

margins_costs.claim: The carbon footprint is currently below 0.5.
margins_costs.quote: Already, our carbon footprint is below 0.5.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall capacity is currently constrained by the environmental approval of 300,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Overall capacity is still constrained by the environment approval of 300,000 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The new NDT line will get commissioned by December and the new peeling line by early November.
orders_capacity.quote: Our new NDT line will get commissioned by December, and the new peeling line will get commissioned by early November.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed manufacturing capacity for billets is 300,000 MTPA.
Installed manufacturing capacity for bright bars is 48,000 TPA.
Revenue from operations for the quarter was INR486 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: And revenue from operations is at INR486 crores, higher by 12%, it's a combination of both.

orders_capacity.claim: The rolling mill has reached its capacity of 3 lakh tons of input following the commissioning of the Kocks Block and Reheating Furnace.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes. So, the rolling mill after the commissioning of the Kocks Block and Reheating Furnace has reached its capacity of 3 lakh tons of input.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is considering a 1:1 debt-equity structure for the new plant to dilute less equity.
capital_allocation.quote: We are now coming around with a conclusion, we are diluting a bit more than required. And therefore, we may look at a 1:1 debt equity.

capital_allocation.claim: Equity raising for the new project will be done through a rights issue in the second half of next calendar year.
capital_allocation.quote: For the equity part, we'll be doing a rights issue, which will happen in the later part of next calendar year, second half of next calendar year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is examining the suspension of dividends for 3-4 years.
capital_allocation.quote: The other thing we are examining, of course, the decision will be taken by the Board, is also to look at examining, suspending the dividend for 3-4 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified project implementation risk as the primary risk for the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: There are several risks. One, there's a project implementation risk. Two, I think that's the biggest risk that we have.

risks_headwinds.claim: Metals have gone up everywhere and the rupee has depreciated due to the Iran war.
risks_headwinds.quote: Metals have gone up everywhere as well as rupee has depreciated.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to file for environmental approval for the SMS within December of the current year.
management_commitments.quote: Land has been finalized for the SMS and we should be filing for environmental approval within December this year.

management_commitments.claim: The new steel plant project is scheduled to be completed by September of 2029 with stabilization by March of 2030.
management_commitments.quote: And we are on track as of now to complete the project by September of '29 and stabilization by March of '30.

management_commitments.claim: The forging plant is expected to come up by March of 2028.
management_commitments.quote: The forging plant is expected to come up by March of '28.

management_commitments.claim: Everything regarding the project conceptualization and modifications will be finalized by March or April of next year.
management_commitments.quote: Everything will be finalized by March, April next year.

management_commitments.claim: Sales for the major import substitution product will start happening from January.
management_commitments.quote: Sales for that will start happening from January.

management_commitments.claim: The Board will take a decision on suspending dividends in the April Board meeting.
management_commitments.quote: The decision, of course, will be taken by the Board in the April Board meeting.

management_commitments.claim: The greenfield plant is targeted for commissioning by FY30.
Commissioning of Line 1 for forging is scheduled for Q3 FY28.
The company expects the new NDT line and new peeling line to be commissioned by September, October of this year.
management_commitments.quote: New NDT line will be commissioned by September, October of this year. And new peeling line will be commissioned by September, October of this year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to increase solar capacity by 50% in about a year to 1.5 years.
management_commitments.quote: We expect in about a year or 1.5 years' time, we'll be going ahead and we'll be increasing the capacity by almost 50% of our solar plant.

management_commitments.claim: The new steel plant is targeted for commissioning in financial year 2029-2030.
management_commitments.quote: As of now, we are still on track to commission the project in the financial year '29-'30.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
